When an institution, company, or organization is founded by someone or by a group of people, they get it started, often by providing the necessary money.
examples: The Independent Labour Party was founded in Bradford on January 13, 1893. [be VERB-ed]

definition.def: When a town, important building, or other place is founded by someone or by a group of people, they cause it to be built.
examples: The town was founded in 1610. [be VERB-ed]

definition.def: If something is founded on a particular thing, it is based on it.
examples: The criticisms are founded on facts as well as on convictions. [+ on]
His game is founded on power and determination.
